description: Build a trader-oriented FX pair setup using spot context, macro differentials, upcoming catalyst risk, and optional COT positioning. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

horizon_events.description: Maximum upcoming catalysts per leg to rank.

include_cot.description: When true, attempt to include COT positioning context for both legs.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

name: fx_trade_setup_task
title: FX Trade Setup Task
